title: Automate upgrade evidence and validate the current maintenance plan
objectives: Automate upgrade evidence and validate the current maintenance plan
Refinement of the accepted AU-44–50 track; the original individual source was unavailable.

tasks.instruction: Prepare the six-host LM → CM → SH → indexer maintenance plan. Stage each teaching package, create/verify current configuration-only archives and independently back up sh01 KV data. Source archives and KV data are different recovery boundaries.

Run playbooks/v7_enterprise_preflight.yml against all six canonical targets. Its native SHA-256 commands and virtual server/info requests must produce actual verified package observations and management version 9.4.1 for each host. A successful empty playbook, command text or a dry run alone does not supply these observations.

Capture a current valid six-host Enterprise maintenance preflight after the automated checks. Keep the fixture clock paused and inspect the native identity, package digest, available storage and replication/search factors. Do not start the package upgrade in this planning exercise.

hints: Inspect the original failure, target scope and active source before changing anything.
Verify native operational state independently of a playbook exit code.

references.purpose: On-change activation and explicit failed-handler recovery
Controlled upgrade order, artifact verification and health prerequisites

checks.label: Current valid six-host plan and independent backup readiness

feedback.success: Actual maintenance outcomes, preserved data and independent verification meet this lesson.
feedback.incomplete: Review current source, version, activation history and independent evidence.
